title: 年度缺陷治理计划

queries.label: 全市预算总额（allocation is_new=1）
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(total_budget) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t_power_company_budget_allocation WHERE is_new=1 AND year='{year}'

queries.label: 各单位预算金额与供电所数（result deleted_flag=0）
queries.sql: SELECT county_company_name AS company, COUNT(DISTINCT power_station_id) AS station_cnt, SUM(budget_amount) AS amount FROM t_power_company_budget_result WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}' GROUP BY county_company_name ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.label: 本范围各供电所预算
queries.sql: SELECT power_station_id, power_station_name, county_company_name AS company, budget_amount FROM t_power_company_budget_result WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}'{company_filter} ORDER BY budget_amount DESC

steps.title: 围绕 16 项指标分析得分

queries.label: 16 项评分标准（含规则原文）
queries.sql: SELECT sort_no, metric_key, metric_name, direction, full_score_pct, pass_score_pct, remark FROM t_power_company_scoring_standard WHERE is_new=1 ORDER BY sort_no

queries.label: 各供电所加权总分与排名
queries.sql: SELECT power_station_name, county_company_name AS company, COUNT(*) AS metric_cnt, SUM(weighted_score) AS total_score FROM t_power_station_score_detail WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}'{company_filter} GROUP BY power_station_name, county_company_name ORDER BY total_score DESC

queries.label: 本范围 16 项平均得分（按加权分降序）
queries.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_name, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(normalized_score) AS avg_score, AVG(weighted_score) AS avg_weighted FROM t_power_station_score_detail WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}'{company_filter} GROUP BY metric_key, metric_name ORDER BY avg_weighted DESC

queries.label: 候选治理项：本范围 vs 全市均分
queries.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_name, AVG(CASE WHEN county_company_name='{company_cmp}' THEN normalized_score END) AS scope_score, AVG(normalized_score) AS city_score, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t_power_station_score_detail WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}' AND metric_key IN ({candidate_keys}) GROUP BY metric_key, metric_name ORDER BY scope_score DESC

queries.label: 候选治理项：原始值为 0 的供电所数（数据缺失识别）
queries.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_name, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN raw_value = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cnt FROM t_power_station_score_detail WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND year='{year}' AND metric_key IN ({candidate_keys}) GROUP BY metric_key, metric_name

queries.label: 最新统计期
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(period_key) AS period FROM t_power_ai_metric_snapshot WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND scope_type='station' AND period_type='yearToDate'

queries.label: 本范围 6 项成效现状
queries.sql: SELECT metric_code, MIN(better_direction) AS better_direction, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(metric_value) AS avg_value, MIN(metric_value) AS min_value, MAX(metric_value) AS max_value FROM t_power_ai_metric_snapshot WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND scope_type='station' AND period_type='yearToDate' AND period_key='{period}'{effect_filter} GROUP BY metric_code

queries.label: 本范围 6 项成效同比（快照对比表）
queries.sql: SELECT metric_code, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(change_rate) AS avg_change, SUM(CASE WHEN change_rate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_base FROM t_power_ai_metric_comparison WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND scope_type='station' AND period_type='yearToDate' AND comparison_type='yearOnYear'{effect_filter_cmp} GROUP BY metric_code

queries.label: 本年度工单按专业与状态
queries.sql: SELECT specialty, work_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(budget_total) AS amount FROM t_power_work_order WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND create_time >= '{year}-01-01' AND create_time < '{next_year}-01-01' GROUP BY specialty, work_status ORDER BY n DESC

queries.label: 本年度工单总体进度
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(budget_total) AS amount, SUM(CASE WHEN actual_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN actual_end_time IS NULL AND plan_end_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM t_power_work_order WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND create_time >= '{year}-01-01' AND create_time < '{next_year}-01-01'

queries.label: 本年度按缺陷类型
queries.sql: SELECT defect_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(budget_total) AS amount FROM t_power_work_order WHERE deleted_flag=0 AND create_time >= '{year}-01-01' AND create_time < '{next_year}-01-01' GROUP BY defect_type ORDER BY n DESC

rules.note: 得分高 = 越需要投入（问题导向类得分高 = 问题更突出）。目标只能从候选 5 项里选 2-3 项；选哪几项由模型依据「本范围 vs 全市」对比与成效现状判断。注意：排名归一化的 4 项在 47 所上的均分恒约为 75.5，全市范围下它们之间无区分度，真正的区分信号是「预算执行」与成效现状。得分不完整的供电所不参与排名。

outline: 二、16 项指标得分分析
